embeds.description: Reason : Request to Join a Later Cohort

messages.author: sahadeep
messages.content:
I wanted to share that I am currently facing a heavy academic workload along with ongoing eye-related health issues. I have been experiencing noticeable eye pain, especially while looking at screens for long periods, which is making it difficult for me to complete the required tasks at the moment.

When I first saw this opportunity connected with the IITM BS Degree programme, I immediately joined because I was very interested and excited about it. However, due to my current health situation, I am struggling to keep up within the present timeline.

I would like to kindly ask if it would be possible for me to join a later cohort of the programme instead. I would also appreciate clarification on whether not completing the current tasks will result in my removal from the programme, and whether that would affect my chances of participating in a future cohort. If needed, I can also provide my medical prescription for reference.

messages.author: imrohitvk
messages.content: Yes <@836880971017748512>. We can consider his request, and he can join a future cohort, as our policy states.
